methodProvenance.partAnchoringRule: R-8, decided from source: a part is admitted only where the DS stamps data-part with that name, or a DS component-identity class pair matches. Scout prose is corroboration, not authority.

engineDivergence.engineDivergence: Engine siblings exist for classic, modern and rustic. The classic engine emits no data-part but does read --ds-* channels through inline style. The modern root class is rottay-tooltip-root while the rustic root class is rottay-tooltip; this difference is load-bearing, see the failureClasses entry for the personality entrance rule.
